title: Case 043: Freight collection needs confirmed pallet dimensions and weight

details.source_role: Nessa Dray, Orris Span shipping coordinator
details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: Freight allocation is paused because pallet dimensions and weight are missing. The shipper must provide measured values before the planner allocates a vehicle.
initial_request: We have the pallet ready. Please tell me which measurements the carrier needs to finish the booking.
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Ask the shipper for measured dimensions and weight before carrier allocation.
next_action.recipient: Nessa Dray, Orris Span shipping coordinator

outcome: The carrier accepts the updated booking data and confirms the collection allocation.
boundaries: Customer measurements are not an independent carrier weighing; allocation is not collection.

events.from: Freight booking desk, Plover Arc Logistics
events.body: DL-043 has one pallet at Orris Span Fabrication, but its dimensions and weight fields are blank. We cannot allocate a collection vehicle from an unspecified pallet size.

events.from: Nessa Dray, Orris Span shipping coordinator
events.body: We have the pallet ready. Please tell me which measurements the carrier needs to finish the booking.

events.to: Nessa Dray, Orris Span shipping coordinator
events.body: Please provide measured length, width and total height including pallet, plus gross weight including packaging, for DL-043. We will pass those actual measurements to the carrier.

events.from: Nessa Dray, Orris Span shipping coordinator
events.body: Measured DL-043: 120 × 100 × 145 cm including pallet, gross weight 310 kg including packaging. One non-stackable pallet; our calibrated warehouse scale supplied the weight.
We accepted the measurements you submitted for DL-043: 120 × 100 × 145 cm, 310 kg gross, one non-stackable pallet. Collection allocation confirmed for 2026-03-17, 11:00–14:00 UTC. Pickup is pending.
